name: OutreachEncounterLog
tagline: Log every street contact, link repeat encounters and never lose a follow-up.
description: A complete street outreach app in one Power Apps component: quick encounter logging (anonymous aliases welcome) with needs, services, referrals and consent, a follow-up board with business rules, a people view that links repeat contacts, a map-free run sheet with found / not-found visits, severe-weather shelter-offer checks and outreach KPIs such as verified rough sleepers and overdue follow-ups. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Quick encounter logging with needs, services and referral chips
Referrals blocked without consent to share
High / urgent welfare risk needs a fast follow-up and a note
Follow-up board New → Follow-up → Referred → Engaged → Resolved / Lost contact
Repeat contacts linked by person reference with a contact timeline
Map-free run sheet by area with Found / Not found and copy-to-text
Lost contact only after the waiting period or not-found attempts
Verified rough sleeper, overdue follow-up and referral KPIs
Bulk follow-up dates / worker / export, undo, audit history
Demo mode with 54 encounters and 25 people
